gloss: to make something look like; to fake; to pretend

definitions.gloss: to make something look like (something else); to disguise as; to fake
definitions.explanation: To arrange things so that something appears to be what it is not, usually to deceive. Most often in the pattern 〜に{見|み}せかける (to make it look like ~).

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見|み}せかける。
examples.english: To make it look like an accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見|み}せかけた⟦{偽物|にせもの}→偽物：11521_nisemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出回|でまわ}っている→出回る：11736_demawaru⟧。
examples.english: Fakes made to look like the real thing are going around.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{荒|あ}らして→荒らす：14057_arasu⟧、⟦{泥棒|どろぼう}→泥棒：01688_dorobou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕業|しわざ}→仕業：10355_shiwaza⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見|み}せかけようとした。
examples.english: The culprit ransacked the room to make it look like the work of a burglar.

notes:
⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ (to show) + 〜かける. The noun is ⟦{見|み}せかけ→見せかけ：09153_misekake⟧ (show, pretense), as in ⟦{見|み}せかけ→見せかけ：09153_misekake⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧ (only for show).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見|み}せかける: to make (a crime) look like an accident
- ⟦{自殺|じさつ}→自殺：03336_jisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見|み}せかける: to make it look like suicide
- ⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見|み}せかける: to pass off as genuine

TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive: the thing disguised takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧, what it is made to look like takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ふり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pretend — about one's own behavior (⟦{寝|ね}た→寝る：00470_neru⟧ふり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧), not about arranging a scene
